item.title: Using Nacos as the Registry
item.description:
This example shows dubbo-go’s service discovery feature with Nacos as the registry. You can view the complete example source code in dubbo-go-samples.

Usage

Specify the registry address in the following way:

ins, _ := dubbo.NewInstance(
	dubbo.WithName("dubbo_registry_nacos_server"),
	dubbo.WithRegistry(
		registry.WithNacos(),
		registry.WithAddress("127.0.0.1:8848"),
	),
	dubbo.WithProtocol(
		protocol.WithTriple(),
		protocol.WithPort(20000),
	),
)

srv, err := ins.NewServer()

item.title: Using ZooKeeper as a registry
item.description:
This guide explains how to use ZooKeeper as a registry in Dubbo-Go. The complete example is available in the dubbo-go-samples/registry/zookeeper directory.

Start ZooKeeper

Start with Docker

Run a local ZooKeeper instance with Docker:

docker run --name dubbo-go-zookeeper --rm -d -p 2181:2181 zookeeper:3.9.5

Confirm that the container is running:

docker ps --filter name=dubbo-go-zookeeper

item.title: Application-level Service Discovery
item.description:
Dubbo-go supports both interface-level registration and application-level service discovery. Interface-level registration stores callable provider URLs directly in the registry. Application-level service discovery stores application instances in the registry, and uses service mapping plus metadata to recover the provider URLs required by consumers.

Application-level service discovery is the current default model. Interface-level registration and application-level service discovery use different registration and subscription paths, and they are not automatically interoperable. A consumer using interface-level discovery cannot discover providers that only register application-level instances; a consumer using application-level discovery cannot discover providers that only register interface-level URLs. Use all during migration if both consumer types must be supported.

item.title: Multiple Registration Centers
item.description:
A Dubbo application can configure multiple registration centers at different interface dimensions. Multiple registration centers can be used for cluster isolation, migration, and various other scenarios. For a more detailed explanation, refer to the Dubbo Java Multiple Registration Center Documentation.

API Configuration Method

ins, _ := dubbo.NewInstance(
	dubbo.WithRegistry(
	 registryWithID("nacos"),
		registry.WithNacos(),
		registry.WithAddress("127.0.0.1:8848"),
	),
	dubbo.WithRegistry(
	 registryWithID("zookeeper"),
		registry.WithZookeeper(),
		registry.WithAddress("127.0.0.1:2181"),
	),
)
